description: VoiceIsolate Pro ONNX model registry — all models execute locally via onnxruntime-web (WebGPU → WASM fallback). NO cloud inference. Models are fetched from same-origin /app/models/*.onnx; vercel.json rewrites resolve those paths to public Vercel Blob URLs. Once cached in Cache API (vip-models-v1), zero network on repeat visits.

models.purpose: Voice Activity Detection — gates the pipeline before heavy ML stages
models.usage_notes: ml-worker.js calls runSileroVAD() which decimates the PCM chunk from the context sample rate to 16 kHz, maintains _vadState between frames, and passes input [1,512] + state [2,1,128] + sr int64(16000).

models.purpose: Voice Activity Detection — int8 quantized variant (same architecture as silero_vad, marginal size delta due to LSTM overhead)
models.source: onnxruntime dynamic int8 quantization of silero_vad.onnx
models.usage_notes: Use alias 'vad_int8' in allowedModels to load this instead of the fp32 variant.

models.purpose: Spectral noise suppressor — lightweight GRU mask predictor operating on magnitude bins
models.export_notes: Spectral-domain stub: accepts magnitude bins [1, numBins], outputs soft mask [1, numBins]. Output bias initialised to 1.5 → sigmoid ≈ 0.82 so untrained model passes ~82% of signal (near-passthrough). Replaces the previous PCM-domain [1,480] stub that mismatched ml-worker input shape. Random weights until a trained RNNoise checkpoint is wired.

models.purpose: Hybrid Demucs v4 — primary vocals / accompaniment source separation
models.export_notes: Blocked: HDemucs uses internal torch.stft on complex tensors. torch.onnx.export at opset 17 fails with SymbolicValueError; opset 20 succeeds tracing but OOMs at graph emit. Until shipped, ml-worker.js falls back to BSRNN-only or DSP-only path.

models.purpose: Band-Split RNN — spectral mask predictor for vocal isolation (secondary path)
models.export_notes: Spectral-domain stub: accepts magnitude bins [1, numBins], outputs soft mask [1, numBins]. Output bias initialised to 2.0 → sigmoid ≈ 0.88. Replaces the previous stereo-PCM [batch,2,time] stub that mismatched ml-worker input shape. Random weights until a trained MUSDB18 checkpoint is dropped.

delivery_notes: silero_vad.onnx, silero_vad_int8.onnx, rnnoise_suppressor.onnx, and bsrnn_vocals.onnx are committed to the repo and served by Vercel from public/app/models/.
demucs_v4_quantized.onnx is not yet exportable; a .placeholder file holds the slot. ml-worker.js disables the Demucs stage cleanly when the file is absent or undersized.
Same-origin fetch keeps COEP (require-corp) satisfied so SharedArrayBuffer stays alive.
After first run all models are cached in Cache API (vip-models-v1) — zero network on repeat visits.
100% local processing guarantee preserved — no audio data leaves the browser.

model_loader_behavior.download_ui: Show progress modal with per-model MB progress bar. Do not block UI thread during fetch.
model_loader_behavior.integrity_check: sha256 field — leave empty to skip check, populate after upload to enable.
